place.summary: Ngong Ping Village functions primarily as a connector in Hong Kong's visitor network. Its strongest observed source market is PH. It receives notable inbound connections from Lantau Island. Visitors often continue to Lantau Island. It performs above its category average on observed experience.

opportunity_cards.title: Frequent companion: Lantau Island
opportunity_cards.detail: Ngong Ping Village frequently appears alongside Lantau Island, suggesting cross-promotion or route packaging potential.

opportunity_cards.title: Strong onward link to Lantau Island
opportunity_cards.detail: Visitors often continue from Ngong Ping Village to Lantau Island, with relatively strong journey experience.

opportunity_cards.title: Concentrated source market
opportunity_cards.detail: Demand appears relatively concentrated in a single source market, suggesting some dependency risk.
